annotations.title: Count AI crawlers in a server log

description: Read access log lines you send and count the AI crawlers in them (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and the rest): requests, errors and the most requested path per crawler, with whose it is and what it collects for. A REST or MCP body holds about 30 KB of log; the page reads far more. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

log.description: Access log lines. Paste lines from your server or CDN log. Any format that prints the user agent works.
